newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Clinton, Hashimoto confer on Pacific Rim policies.
newsitem.headline: Clinton, Hashimoto confer on Pacific Rim policies.

text.p: U.S. President Bill Clinton met Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto on Sunday for talks designed to help shape U.S. policy in the Pacific Rim.
Clinton last met Hashimoto in Tokyo in April, when the two formally agreed on a long-term security pact.
The atmosphere was relaxed and friendly as the two leaders posed for pictures at the start of their talks.

When Hashimoto was asked if he had any plans to surprise Clinton with a gift -- as he did in April by presenting the U.S. president with a saxophone -- he said through an interrpeter: "It's a diplomatic secret."

Clinton, who met the Japanese leader in a conference room of the Central Bank of the Philippines, also held private meetings on Sunday with Chinese President Jiang Zemin and South Korean President Kim Young-sam.
The leaders are in the Philippines for the annual meeting of the leaders of the 18-member Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) forum.
